section: Closing strips and fillers for Maxima and Intarsio
source_pages: printed p.434 / PDF 436 (subset extracted: the H.36 row of the third position)
family_note: No family-level keys, for the reason given in fillers_h78.json. This one carries the point further: a wall filler HANGS, and it hangs because wall_h36.json says the family does. Nothing here has to know that, and nothing here may restate it.

filler_wall_unit.description: Wall unit filler in door finishes from 2,3 to 15 cm - with one-piece bottom
filler_wall_unit.notes: PB = H.36 is the same wall letter wall_h36.json already holds. THE SUFFIX 0151 MEANS SOMETHING ELSE HERE than it does on a B or C prefix, where it is a front-only strip with no carcass at all: this one is a box with a one-piece bottom. Same four digits, two different articles, one page apart - rule 4, and the reason the registry stores rows rather than a grammar.
